title: The Ossie AI data policy is enforced: raw-row egress (/ai/ossie/row-detail) is refused under the aggregated tier while schema metadata stays available

criteria.given: a logged-in user on the demo launcher, whose AI data policy is at the aggregated tier (the launcher's demo-mode default)
criteria.then: POST /rest/saiku/api/ai/ossie/row-detail is refused with 403 and the PERMISSION_DENIED envelope (field ai.policy, available [full]) — raw warehouse rows require the full tier
GET /rest/saiku/api/ai/ossie/schema/Flights/Flights still answers 200 — schema metadata stays available under a restrictive tier (the gate is per data kind, not a blanket block)

steps.name: row-detail raw rows are refused under the aggregated tier
schema metadata stays available — the gate is per data kind
